title: How Third Moment Research runs 10,000 agents for 36+ hours

beats.text: OpenAI just dropped a massive paradigm shift: Third Moment Research is officially live, enabling 10,000 autonomous agents to run for 36 hours straight without collapse.
beats.visual_focus: Hero announcement card with OpenAI emblem.

beats.text: Previously, multi-agent frameworks hit the wall of degradation. Context drift and token loops meant most systems imploded after mere minutes. Costs scaled linearly, making long-term autonomy a financial death trap.
beats.visual_focus: Chart showing exponential cost curve flattening.

beats.text: The secret? A radical distillation routing engine. GPT-6 Astra handles reasoning, Sol manages execution, and Codex locks down security. They’ve offloaded task-switching to a dedicated Daybreak orchestrator that minimizes token churn.
